bcoreBase.scope: Same C and work counts; bfin GCC differs from Clang. OP-1 web backend defaults: copy-and-patch, cold tier, background LLVM promotion (100000/16), 8 ms slices and split LLVM. Bare-metal 16 MiB RAM, no firmware, device deadlines or audio pacing.

methodology.round: One new Chromium process per round; one fresh Worker and emulator per case/runtime
methodology.timing: Unchanged official V8 v7 warmup/measurement batches, minimum 32 calls; host monotonic clock in both guests
methodology.order: Rotate case order; alternate dynarmic/bcore order within each case across rounds
methodology.ratio: bcore per-iteration time / dynarmic time; above 1 favors dynarmic
methodology.aggregate: Per round combine Crypto/EarleyBoyer cases geometrically, then eight suites equally; summarize round ratios
methodology.scope: Complete QuickJS execution paths: ARM and Blackfin ISA, compilers, libc builds, JITs and scheduling differ

ratio: bcore ms per iteration / dynarmic ms per iteration; above 1 favors dynarmic
aggregation: Compute paired case ratios and equal-weight eight-suite geometric means within each round, then summarize complete round ratios; do not divide unpaired time medians
